summary_en: Maruichi Sangyo will acquire up to 2.5 million shares (12.6% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for up to ¥2.61 billion via N-NET3 off-auction trading at ¥1,044 per share on 30 September 2026. Mitsubishi Corporation, a major shareholder, plans to sell all its holdings in the company.
title_en: Notice Regarding Self-Share Acquisition and Self-Share Off-Auction Trading (N-NET3) and Change in Major Shareholders
translation_en_brief:
Maruichi Sangyo decided on 29 September 2026 to acquire up to 2.5 million shares of its common stock, representing 12.6% of issued shares excluding treasury stock, for a maximum amount of ¥2.61 billion. The acquisition will be executed on 30 September 2026 at ¥1,044 per share via N-NET3 off-auction trading on the Nagoya Stock Exchange, with results announced after the 8:45 a.m. trading session closes.

The company stated the acquisition is undertaken to execute flexible capital policy in response to changes in the management environment. The acquisition order is valid only for the specified trading time, and there is a possibility that part or all of the acquisition may not be executed depending on market conditions.

In connection with this acquisition, Mitsubishi Corporation, the company's major shareholder, has notified the company of its plan to sell all ordinary shares it holds in Maruichi Sangyo. This will result in a change in major shareholders, which the company will announce promptly once confirmed.
